title: Koperasi: set the earned-trust rule for task payouts
description: The three payout tiers: no vote up to auto_max for a contributor backed by trusted_after different sources (within poster_daily_auto a day per poster), one other member up to one_vote_max, a DAO bounty above that.
summary: Trust rule: no vote up to {{auto_max}} yocto after {{trusted_after}} sources, one vote up to {{one_vote_max}} yocto

fields.name: auto_max
fields.label: Paid with no vote, up to
fields.help: Amount in yoctoNEAR (1 NEAR = 1 followed by 24 zeros).

fields.name: one_vote_max
fields.label: Paid after one other member approves, up to
fields.help: Amount in yoctoNEAR (1 NEAR = 1 followed by 24 zeros). At least the no-vote limit.

fields.name: trusted_after
fields.label: Different sources before a contributor is trusted

fields.name: poster_daily_auto

fields.help: Amount in yoctoNEAR (1 NEAR = 1 followed by 24 zeros).
